addons.name: Spool Up: 2026 Race Starts
addons.author: nyannoying
addons.summary: The 2026 start the game leaves out, on F1 2026 cars: a 5 s Pre-Start, a turbo you spool yourself, AI that can fumble and the low-output safety net. Offline Grand Prix and Career, races and sprints. Other cars keep the game's normal start.
addons.description:
## The 2026 start the game leaves out

F1 25's 2026 Season Pack brings the 2026 cars, but not the 2026 start. Spool Up adds it: the blue Pre-Start lights, a turbo you spool yourself, AI cars that can get it wrong, and the low-output safety net.

The real 2026 cars have no MGU-H, so nothing keeps the turbo spinning on the grid. Drivers build boost on the revs before lights out, and the FIA added a five-second warning to give them the time. Get it wrong here and the grid drives away from you.

### Quick start

1. Steam version of F1 25 with the official 2026 Season Pack and Swofty Launcher 1.8.38 or newer. Install Spool Up from the Addon Browser, then restart the game.
2. Start an offline race with the F1 2026 cars, with or without a formation lap.
3. When the lights flash blue, hold 10,000 rpm or more until the TURBO SPOOL gauge says FULL. Keep the revs up through the red lights.
4. Go when the lights go out. You have no MGU-K until 50 km/h.

### What you get

- **Pre-Start:** for 5 s before the first red light the light panels along the track flash blue, the five lamps of the game's own start lights on your HUD flash blue, and the game's lap counter says PRE-START. Then the game's own five lights. Also after a formation lap. A red flag restart has no Pre-Start: the game gives you no throttle until its red lights begin, so you spool the turbo under the red lights there.
- **Turbo spool:** a TURBO SPOOL gauge under the start lights, drawn by the game's own HUD. Move it, resize it or turn it off in the game's HUD customisation, where it is called Turbo Spool. Hold 10,000 rpm or more and it fills in 3 s, then turns green and says FULL. Drop below that while you wait and it falls again. With an empty gauge the engine has about a third of its power when the lights go out.
- **Low-output safety net:** a car on low boost that accelerates abnormally slowly gets just enough MGU-K from its own battery to hold a minimum acceleration until 50 km/h. The game's own message box shows LOW-OUTPUT START, or SLOW CAR AHEAD when it is an AI car in front of you. The net turns a disastrous start into a bad one, never a good one.
- **AI that can get it wrong:** each AI car gets a random start: most are clean, some poor, about 1 in 20 fumbled. A fumbled car bogs for 1.5 s, so gaps open up on the grid.
- **No MGU-K off the line:** the game's 2026 car data already has no deployment below 50 km/h, as in the rules. Spool Up keeps it that way for every car the net does not help.

### What a start costs

Time from lights out to 50 km/h, measured in the game with the default settings (Shanghai):

- You, bar 75 to 100 %: 1.8 to 1.95 s
- You, bar 60 to 70 %: 2.05 to 2.2 s
- You, bar under 30 %: about 3.5 s
- AI cars, median of the grid: 2.0 to 2.3 s
- A fumbled AI car: 3.0 to 3.4 s

### Requirements

- F1 25 on Steam, build 25251167. The EA app version is not supported. After a game update Spool Up stays idle and the game runs as normal, until a new version is out.
- The official 2026 Season Pack, for the F1 2026 cars.
- Swofty Launcher 1.8.38 or newer.
- Offline Grand Prix, Driver Career or My Team, races and sprints.

Other cars keep the game's normal start. Spool Up reads every car at the lights, and a grid with any non-2026 ERS car stays standard.

### Settings

In ADDON SETTINGS on the home menu (directly under Career, or F9 / R3), or in the launcher. **Custom settings are untested so far:** every start raced so far ran on the defaults.

- **Pre-Start phase** (On): the 5 s blue phase before the first red light.
- **2026 launch physics** (On): the turbo spool and the random AI starts. Off gives every car the game's normal launch.
- **Low-output start safety net** (On): the MGU-K help and the warnings.
- **Apply launch physics to AI** (On): off gives every AI car a normal launch, with no bad starts, which makes your start much harder.
- **Turbo spool time** (3 s, from 1 to 8): seconds at high revs to reach full boost.
- **Spool revs** (10,000 rpm, from 6,000 to 14,000): the engine speed above which the turbo gains boost.

### Beta status

- Raced so far: Driver Career races at Shanghai and Suzuka and a two-round Grand Prix, with the default settings. My Team and sprints run the same code.
- **Custom settings are untested** in a real race.
- A red flag restart is untested in a real race. Its start without Pre-Start is new in 0.3.1.
- Not tried in a real race yet either: a start after a driven formation lap, a grid of non-2026 cars and the warnings in the game's message box.
- The trackside panels flash blue in the game's log, but nobody has seen them on screen yet.

### Good to know

- The start lights on the gantry stay the game's own: they have no blue lamps. How many blue panels you can see from your grid slot depends on the track, and the blue lamps on your HUD show at every track. The warnings are messages on your HUD, not lights on the cars.
- The blue lamps, the spool gauge, PRE-START and the warnings are all drawn by the game's own HUD, so they follow its layout and scale. Only when the game's HUD is missing or refuses them does Spool Up draw them itself.
- DLSS Frame Generation does not hide the blue lamps or the gauge, because the game draws them. Spool Up's own drawing, used only when the game's HUD refuses them, does not show with Frame Generation on.
- Aborted starts and extra formation laps (FIA Articles B5.8 and B5.9) are not added.
- AI starts are random. Driver skill does not change them.
- The net's MGU-K is what the game's deploy code allows: none in ERS mode None, none with an empty battery.
- Online, split screen, Story and F1 World keep the game's own start.
- Works alongside [Terminal Damage](https://github.com/nyannoying1337/f1-25-terminal-damage).

**Something not working?** Each part has its own setting: turn off only that part for now and send me your log.

**Your log:** loader.log in the newest folder of %LOCALAPPDATA%\Swofty\sessions (while the game runs: the swofty folder inside your F1 25 folder). Post it in a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/nyannoying1337/f1-25-spool-up/issues).

### Source and license

Source, FIA references and how it works: [GitHub](https://github.com/nyannoying1337/f1-25-spool-up).

This release uses the [Spool Up Attribution License 1.0](https://github.com/nyannoying1337/f1-25-spool-up/blob/main/LICENSE), a custom license. Published mods/projects using substantial parts must credit Spool Up by nyannoying with a link to the project.

Fan-made. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FIA, Formula 1, EA or Codemasters.

# Spool Up 0.3.1 beta

A fix for red flag restarts.

## New

addons.name: F1 25 RE-Optimization
addons.author: xanpavle (port by Swofty)
addons.summary: xanpavle's renderer optimisation: a tuned graphics delta, in-engine enforcement of the tuned values, engine renderer overrides and a GPU-aware upscaler. Offline single-player only.
addons.description:
[xanpavle](https://github.com/xanpavle)'s renderer optimisation for F1 25, ported to Swofty Launcher with his permission. It makes the renderer do less work each frame while keeping the look of your graphics preset. Based on upstream 0.3.1, under the MIT licence.

### What it does
- **Graphics profile:** on top of the preset you pick, it lowers the settings that cost the most GPU time: volumetric fog resolution, shadow map sizes, crowd shadows, SSR and SSAO quality, grass and crowd draw distances, particles, hair, god rays and motion blur. Resolution, your preset, mirrors, ray-traced shadows and reflections, rain and the upscaler quality level stay as you set them.
- **In-engine enforcement:** the game clamps shadow, fog and crowd values to your preset after it reads its settings; the addon holds the tuned values inside the engine after that clamp. **Cheaper** (the default) uses the lower of your value and the tuned one, **Target** always uses the tuned value, and **Off** leaves the engine alone.
- **Renderer overrides:** turns on variable rate shading and async compute, and caps ground-cover and static instance counts.
- **Upscaler:** picks the one your GPU supports, with DLSS on RTX cards, FSR 3 on GTX, AMD and most Intel GPUs, and XeSS on Arc, or keeps your in-game choice.

Every option is on its row on the **Addons** page and under **ADDON SETTINGS** in game.

### Good to know
- It's made for the Steam build of F1 25 (25251167). On any other build its hooks stay off, and `swofty/loader.log` says so.
- It doesn't touch your `hardware_settings_config.xml`: it lowers the values in memory as the game reads them.
- Changes to the profile, the upscaler or the enforcement mode apply on the next launch.
- Its log lines in `swofty/loader.log` start with `[re-opt]`.

latest.changelog: No more hitches from the addon's own checks: the state write at 90 s and the video memory check at 3 and 10 minutes took 8-27 ms on the game's frame thread; file writes, the DXGI query and log lines now run on a worker thread, and the frame callback no longer unsubscribes. A frame check from the race itself: a report 5 minutes after the first session start (fps, 1% low, hitches, video memory). When still over the video memory budget with the VRAM guard on, the log counts the installed car, livery, helmet, suit and track mods and names the biggest. The memory check uses the SDK's cached one (swofty/mem.hpp). Manifest: repository link and compat (launcher >=1.8.36, platforms steam and ea).

versions.changelog: No more hitches from the addon's own checks: the state write at 90 s and the video memory check at 3 and 10 minutes took 8-27 ms on the game's frame thread; file writes, the DXGI query and log lines now run on a worker thread, and the frame callback no longer unsubscribes. A frame check from the race itself: a report 5 minutes after the first session start (fps, 1% low, hitches, video memory). When still over the video memory budget with the VRAM guard on, the log counts the installed car, livery, helmet, suit and track mods and names the biggest. The memory check uses the SDK's cached one (swofty/mem.hpp). Manifest: repository link and compat (launcher >=1.8.36, platforms steam and ea).

0.3.8: Upscaler auto no longer switches older AMD cards to FSR 3. AMD cards from before RDNA (RX 400 / 500, Vega) and AMD drivers older than 24.1 keep your own upscaler, after a "pipeline state doesn't exist" report on an RX 570 with driver 23.11.1; choosing FSR 3 yourself still works. Nothing is written to %LOCALAPPDATA% any more (the 0.3.6 fallback is removed). 0.3.7 (also in this update): adaptive VRAM guard - when the game went over the card's video memory budget, the next launch puts textures, shadow maps, fog and car reflections at Potato's sizes, and switches back off once the game fits easily; the 1% low and hitch counts start at the first session start; empty telemetry no longer shows as Melbourne.

Adaptive VRAM guard: the frame check measures video memory at 3 and 10 minutes. When the game went over the card's budget (8 GB cards did on Balanced, with long hitches), the next launch puts textures, shadow maps, fog and car reflections at Potato's sizes; it switches back off once the game fits easily. Never above your own settings. Frame check: 1% low and hitch counts now start at the first session start, so menus and loading no longer count. Empty telemetry no longer shows as Melbourne.

Weak-CPU guard: older or 4-thread CPUs get CPU-side cuts (crowd, particles, trees, ground cover) on any preset, and Recommended no longer steps down to Potato at 1440p there. 4 GB cards stream textures at Potato's level. Crash safe mode falls back to %LOCALAPPDATA% when the addon folder can't be written and logs how the last launch ended. Frame check adds 1% low, hitch counts, on-track median, VRAM use and frame-gen notes. Log: CPU, GPU driver, laptop power, Wine/Proton, session and race start.

**From the first 0.3.4 logs (upstream 0.3.5).**

- **Gaming laptops are tuned for the real GPU.** On hybrid laptops (e.g. RTX 3050 Laptop GPU + AMD graphics in the CPU) Windows often leaves the NVIDIA card out of the display list, so the addon saw only the integrated graphics: Recommended picked Potato and Auto skipped DLSS. It now lists every present adapter, picks the discrete GPU, and logs all adapters it found.
- **Frame generation stays on.** In F1 25 frame generation belongs to the upscaler. With frame generation on in your settings, your upscaler is kept instead of switched (switching can turn frame generation off and cost far more fps than it gains).
- **Recommended also looks at your resolution.** A Balanced-tier GPU at 1440p or more (3440x1440, 4K) gets Potato. Quality-tier GPUs are not stepped down.
- **Frame check over 30-second windows**, reported after 3 and 10 minutes with min / median / max fps; a cap counts only when at least half the windows sat at 60 (or 30) fps. It used to look only at seconds 20-90, mostly menus.

Offline / single-player only, as always.

**Fix from the first 0.3.3 log (upstream 0.3.4).**

- **Sky shadow low LOD was pinned OFF on every preset**, which made it slightly more expensive when you had it on: the one place the "never raise" rule was broken. Now only Potato sets it, and to ON (the cheaper value); Balanced and Quality leave it as yours.
- **Engine saves log one line per burst** instead of about 25 lines in 40 ms, and the line now says it plainly: your own values are put back in the saved file, so the file on disk keeps your settings.

Offline / single-player only, as always.

**Follow-up from the first 0.3.2 Send Logs (upstream 0.3.3).** Crashes there happened just as often with the addon off, so none is pinned on it.

- **Log header covers both settings reads**, labeled `[mount load]` / `[config load]`, and each says whether it is your own settings file. 0.3.2 logged only the first read, which was the game's defaults (every PC showed 1280x720).
- **Quality respects "Keep ray-traced AO and DDGI"** (it used to turn both on anyway).
- **VRAM guard is now 6 GB or less** (8 GB cards handle the tuned values); on those cards ray-traced AO and DDGI are never switched on, even in Target.
- **Potato no longer changes the sky shadow cascade count** (a known crash risk below 4).
- **Frame cap check:** if nearly every frame sits at 60 (or 30) fps, the log says something caps fps (vsync in the game or driver, a 60 Hz screen, a limiter), even when the settings file says vsync is off.
- **Clearer crash safe mode line** when the stock launch crashed too.

Offline / single-player only, as always.

**Fixes from the players' Send Logs data (upstream 0.3.2).**

- **Never more expensive than your own settings.** The profile used to write fixed values, so on a Low preset it raised shadow and fog maps above your own. Now a value is changed only when that costs the same or less; the rest stays yours (logged as `kept`). Only enforcement **Target** may raise settings.
- **Potato could be slower than Balanced**: its cloud setting was the Ultra value. Fixed, and under Potato rain, grass and fog are never forced on.
- **Integrated graphics keep their upscaler** (Radeon APU, Intel Iris Xe / UHD): Auto no longer forces FSR 3 there. A discrete card is always picked over the CPU's graphics.
- **VRAM guard**: on 8 GB or less and on integrated graphics, shadow maps, fog maps, car reflections and texture streaming are never raised, even in Target.
- **Recommended preset** (new default): picked from your GPU and its VRAM at launch.
- **Crash safe mode** (new option, on): if a launch crashes before the game has run for 90 s, the next launch runs stock; two in a row keep it stock for 3 launches.
- **Log header** in `swofty/loader.log`: version (now correctly 0.3.2), GPU, VRAM, preset, mode, upscaler, resolution, vsync, frame cap, frame gen and every changed value. It also notes when vsync or a frame cap means no gain can show.

Offline / single-player only, as always.
New addon icon (xanpavle's logo) and the FPS results poster at the top of the README. No code or option changes.

**Presets (upstream 0.3.0).** New **Preset** option:
- **Quality** (for Ultra Max / Ultra High): keeps ray-traced AO and DDGI, grass, hair and sharper shadows.
- **Balanced** (for High / Medium): the original tuning, unchanged. Default.
- **Potato** (for Low / Ultra Low): cuts everything that costs real GPU time, ray tracing included. Mirrors are never touched.

Measured upstream on an RX 7800 XT at 1440p (Austria wet, FSR 3 + frame gen): stock Ultra High 142 FPS, Quality 154, Balanced 171, Potato 302.

**Imola fix (upstream 0.2.8).** *Static instance caps* now defaults to **off**: at 20000 the engine dropped Imola's barriers, TecPro blocks and guardrails. If you turned it on yourself, turn it off for Imola.

Each preset has its own in-engine values; the sky shadow cascade count always stays at 4, because forcing it lower makes the game quit at launch.

Offline / single-player only, as always.
First release in the Addon Browser.

addons.name: Bahrain Reverse
addons.author: Twilight Sparkle
addons.summary: The full Bahrain Grand Prix circuit driven anti-clockwise: same start line and pit lane, the lap and the grid turned round, on F1 25's Bahrain.
addons.description:
# Bahrain Reverse for F1 25 (1.0.0)

By Twilight Sparkle. The full **Bahrain International Circuit** Grand Prix layout, driven **anti-clockwise** on F1 25's
own Bahrain. It uses the same start/finish line and pit lane, with the lap, the grid and the pit lane all turned round.
The hairpin at the end of the back straight becomes a flat-out approach, and the old last corners become a tricky
opening sequence. That gives a 5.412 km lap with 15 corners.

It shows up as **Bahrain Reverse** in the track lists. It has its own track slot, so stock Bahrain and its records stay
as they are.

## What's in it

- **The lap turned round.** The grid is on the main straight behind the start line. Lap timing, sectors, mini-sectors
  and track limits all work in the new direction.
- **AI made for the reverse lap.** Braking points, apexes, braking zones and gear hints are set up for every corner in
  the new direction, including the fast AmEx corner and the hairpin. AI energy and fuel use follow the reverse lap.
- **The pit lane driven backwards.** The old pit exit becomes the entry and the old entry becomes the exit. Garages are
  on the driver's left, with each team's garage, pit crew, pit wall and pitboards in the new order. The 80 km/h limit
  starts at the limiter line.
- **2026 rules.** Straight-mode zones on the four straights end before the braking zones. DRS zones, and Overtake Mode
  detection and activation after the last corner, are set for the reverse lap.
- **Replay cameras for the new direction.** 26 TV cameras film the cars coming towards them all round the lap, with clear
  views past trees, poles, buildings and sponsor boards. Pit-lane and pit-stop replays and highlight shots are set up
  for the reverse lap.
- **Maps for the reverse lap.** The track-select map, HUD full map and minimap with their sectors, and the 2026 maps.
- **Stats for the lap.** 5.412 km, 15 corners, 57 laps for a full-distance race. It starts with no lap record, ready
  for yours.

## Known limits

- The trackside DRS, straight-mode and braking-distance boards still face the normal direction.
- The AI's tyre wear and difficulty data come from the normal Grand Prix lap.

## Credits

Track and scenery: Codemasters / EA (F1 25). Reverse layout: Twilight Sparkle, with Swofty Launcher and its modding
tools.

addons.description:
# Bahrain Shorter for F1 25 (1.0.0)

By Twilight Sparkle. **Bahrain Short** with a faster first corner. Instead of the Turn 1 hairpin, the lap takes the
asphalt cut-through on the inside of Turn 1. That makes a fast right-hander off the main straight that rejoins
the track after the old Turn 2. From there the lap runs as on Bahrain Short: Turns 3 and 4, the infield link road,
the back straight and the last corners. That gives a 3.7 km lap of under a minute.

It shows up as **Bahrain Shorter** in the Grand Prix and Time Trial track lists. It has its own track slot, so
stock Bahrain and Bahrain Short stay as they are.

## What's in it

- **A new Turn 1.** The racing line, track limits, lap timing and sectors are made for the cut-through. The old
  hairpin counts as off-track. If you drive onto it, the game puts you back on track.
- **A shorter pit exit.** The pit lane ends on the main straight and swings into the cut-through. The 80 km/h
  limiter stays on to the end of the pit lane, so cars leaving the pits make the corner.
- **The old hairpin closed off.** Tyre walls with arrow boards block it at both ends.
- **Maps for the new lap.** The track-select outline, the HUD full map and minimap with their sectors, the car
  monitor map and the 2026 maps all show the new Turn 1.
- **Replay cameras for the new corner.** The long-lens cameras on the main straight see over the new tyre walls
  and follow the cars into the corner.
- **2026 rules.** Straight-mode zones on the three straights, and Overtake Mode with detection and activation
  after the last corner. The main-straight DRS and straight-mode zones end before the new Turn 1.
- **Everything else from Bahrain Short.** The infield link, its closures and cleaned shadows carry over.
- **Stats for the shorter lap.** 3.717 km, 9 corners, 83 laps for a full-distance race and an 80 km/h pit lane
  limit. It starts with no lap record, ready for yours.

## Known limits

- The AI's tyre wear, fuel use and ERS data come from the Grand Prix layout.
- The DRS and straight-mode boards beside the track stand where they stand on Bahrain Short.
- In the car, the pit limiter releases about 220 m past the painted pit-exit line.

## Credits

Layout: Codemasters / EA (F1 2020's Bahrain Short), with the new Turn 1 by Twilight Sparkle. Scenery:
Codemasters / EA (F1 25). Port: Twilight Sparkle, with Swofty Launcher and its modding tools.

addons.name: SWOFTY 2021
addons.author: Swofty
addons.summary: The 2021 season: all 10 teams on their own chassis with parody-sponsor liveries, 2 special liveries, new driver heads and 2021 car physics, in its own Grand Prix and Time Trial box.
addons.description:
- All 10 teams of the 2021 season with custom made chassis and liveries (with parody sponsors), including 2 special liveries from the season: McLaren at Monaco and Red Bull in Turkey.
- Hand-made driver heads of various 2021 drivers no longer in the game.
- Engine sounds, AI pace order and physics of the 2021 cars, built to feel like the last cars before ground effect.

Credits: Driver faces made from Wikimedia Commons photos: Sebastian Vettel by Marc Alvarado (CC BY-SA 2.0), Antonio Giovinazzi by Marc Alvarado (CC BY 2.0), Mick Schumacher by Sven Mandel (CC BY-SA 4.0), Kimi Räikkönen by Antigorky, cropped and improved by RanZag (CC BY-SA 3.0), Nicholas Latifi by TIB1245L (CC BY-SA 4.0), Nikita Mazepin by Somanyhorsesru журнал (CC BY 3.0). Box tile photo by rsyphotography (David Yuen) (CC BY 2.0). Team and driver names set in Saira (SIL Open Font License).

latest.changelog: The cars now run 13-inch wheels on tall-sidewall tyres, like the real 2021 cars, instead of F1 25's 18-inch tyres with oversized rims.

versions.changelog: The cars now run 13-inch wheels on tall-sidewall tyres, like the real 2021 cars, instead of F1 25's 18-inch tyres with oversized rims.
Antonio Giovinazzi no longer looks like Esteban Ocon. His photo face was laid on Esteban Ocon's head model, so in game he read as Esteban Ocon; he now uses the head model of a driver from outside F1.
Each car now plays its own engine manufacturer's sound from F1 2021. Before, every car played the F1 25 sound of the car it was built on, often another manufacturer's.
Fixes the cockpit steering wheel: paddles and dials sit where they belong, and the wheel's carbon faceplate no longer shows see-through or stretched.

Every car's driver, steering wheel and cockpit camera now sit where the car's own cockpit expects them: the steering wheel no longer hides inside the chassis, and drivers no longer sink into or sit on top of the cockpit. The rear-facing onboard cameras no longer look through the T-cam pod.

Much cleaner liveries: logos read whole without smudges or ghost copies, including the Red Bull, Honda special, McLaren and Ferrari front wings. Driver suits now show their front designs on the front and load in their team's colours with boots, with parody sponsors on all kit. Driver select shows every driver's own name, and the onboard camera pod sits where the cameras expect it.
Fixes the cars having no default setups: the AI now runs proper setups instead of grounding the car and running wide, and the cars are much easier to drive.
The front and rear wing endplates now show their logos whole instead of chopped up, and the liveries have far fewer speckles and holes in the logos and stripes.

Much better frame rates: cars further away now use lighter models instead of the full close-up model. The onboard camera pod is back on top of the airbox on every car, placed where the game's cameras expect it. Texture clean-up in the cockpit.
First release.

addons.name: FFB Overhaul
addons.author: Jonno
addons.summary: Fixes F1 25's wheel force feedback: smoother output (also at low frame rates), no clipping flat-tops, kerb and crash spike guard, straight-line oscillation damping, per-effect strength, minimum force for gear and belt wheels, automatic recovery when FFB drops out, and a settings panel on the pause screen (F8).
addons.description:
# FFB Overhaul

**Wheel force feedback fixes for F1 25**

> **Early release (1.0.0).** Every part has been tested against the game files, but not yet on many wheels in a
> running game. Please post your wheel, your settings and how it felt. If anything feels wrong, switch the addon off in
> game and you get the stock FFB back straight away.

## What it fixes

FFB Overhaul works inside the game's own force feedback system, between the car physics and your wheel. No extra
software, no files replaced, and nothing outside the wheel is touched (gamepads are left alone).

| Problem | What FFB Overhaul does |
|---|---|
| Notchy, stepped or grainy FFB on direct drive (better when you cap at 60 FPS) | **Smoothing** between the game's updates, and an optional faster **wheel update rate**. The game only sends to the wheel every 11 ms, so above 90 FPS the updates arrive unevenly. |
| Heavy corners feel numb (clipping) | **Anti-clipping**: headroom before the game's hard limit plus a soft knee, so peaks keep their shape instead of going flat. |
| Crashes rattle the wheel violently | **Crash jolts: Softened**. The game flips the crash force left-right every frame; this turns it into one push. |
| Kerbs and impacts snap the wheel | **Spike guard**: limits how fast the force can jump. Small vibrations still come through. |
| Wheel shakes itself on straights | **Oscillation guard**: detects the shake at speed and damps it only while it's happening, so the wheel isn't heavy the rest of the time. |
| Weightless wheel in the pit lane and hairpins | **Low-speed weight** that fades out by about 120 km/h. |
| Dead centre on G29 / G920 / G923 / T300 | **Minimum force** for gear and belt wheels. |
| Can't feel the tyres or the grip | **Separate strength for each effect** (tyre forces, centring spring, slip vibration, wheelspin and lock-up vibration) and a **road detail boost**. |
| FFB disappears after a pit stop, flashback, restart or alt-tab | **Auto-recover** rebuilds the wheel's effects (what re-calibrating does), using the game's own recovery code. **Ctrl+Shift+F** does it by hand. |
| Wheel keeps pushing after a session ends or during loading | **Stuck-force guard** releases the force. |

There's also an optional **on-screen FFB meter** with a clipping light, to make tuning easy.

## Requirements

- F1 25 on Steam, build 25251167 (the current one)
- [Swofty Launcher](https://f1.swofty.net/guide/installation) 1.6.11 or later
- A wheel that uses DirectInput or the Thrustmaster driver: Fanatec, Moza, Simagic, Simucube, Asetek, Cammus,
  Logitech, Thrustmaster and others

To uninstall, disable or remove it on the Addons page.

## Quick setup

Set **Wheel type** first. Every setting left on "Auto" follows it.

| Wheel | Wheel type | Then try |
|---|---|---|
| Direct drive (Fanatec DD / CSL DD, Moza, Simagic, Simucube, Asetek) | Direct drive | In-game Wheel Damper 0, addon Game damper 50 %, Wheel update rate "Fast" if you run over 90 FPS |
| Belt (Thrustmaster T300 / TX / T-GT, Fanatec CSL / CSW) | Belt | Defaults; Smoothing Light |
| Gear (Logitech G29 / G920 / G923) | Gear | Minimum force Auto (6 %); go up to 8-10 % if the centre still feels dead |

Keep the in-game FFB settings as your base (Strength 70-100 is a good start). While tuning, turn on the **On-screen FFB
meter**. The bar shows the force going to the wheel, the purple bar shows the damper, and **CLIP** lights red when the
force would have been flat-topped.

<details>
<summary>All settings</summary>

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Enable FFB Overhaul | On | Off = the game's FFB untouched |
| Wheel type | Not sure | Picks the Auto values |
| Overall strength | 100 % | 25-200 %, on top of the in-game strength |
| Anti-clipping | On | Headroom and a soft knee for peaks |
| Smoothing | Auto | Off / Light / Medium / Strong. Stronger = smoother but less road texture |
| Wheel update rate | Game default | Game (max 90 Hz) / Fast (max 250 Hz) / Every frame |
| Spike guard | Auto | Off / Light / Medium / Strong |
| Minimum force | Auto | 0-12 %. Auto: gear 6 %, belt 3 %, direct drive 0 % |
| Game damper | 100 % | Scales the game's wheel damper |
| Low-speed weight | 30 % | Extra damping when slow |
| Oscillation guard | On | Damps the wheel shaking itself on straights |
| Tyre forces | 100 % | Main steering weight: cornering load, grip, understeer |
| Centring spring | 100 % | The pull back to centre with steering angle |
| Slip vibration | 100 % | Tyres sliding sideways |
| Wheelspin & lock-up vibration | 100 % | |
| Crash jolts | Softened | Game / Softened / Off |
| Road detail boost | 0 % | Brings out bumps and grip changes without adding steady weight; try 20-40 % |
| Auto-recover lost FFB | On | Rebuilds the wheel's effects when FFB goes silent at speed, after alt-tab, after send errors and at each new session |
| Reset hotkey (Ctrl+Shift+F) | On | Manual rebuild |
| Stuck-force guard | On | Releases a force the game left on |
| On-screen FFB meter | Off | For tuning |
| Detailed logging | Off | Writes stats to the Swofty log every 5 s, for bug reports |

</details>

## Reporting a problem

- Turn on **Detailed logging**, drive a lap, and post the lines starting with `[ffb-overhaul]` from the Swofty log,
  with your wheel model and settings.
- The `[ffb-overhaul] ready: ...` line says which parts started. After a game update some parts may switch themselves
  off; the log says which ones.

## Known limitations

- Gamepad vibration isn't changed.
- Logitech TrueForce wheels get the output processing, but the TrueForce audio-haptic effects are the game's own.
- Made for Steam build 25251167. After a game update, wait for an update of the addon if the log shows parts switched
  off.
- Single-player and offline use. It doesn't change car physics, only what your wheel feels.

## Credits

By Jonno. Built on the [Swofty](https://f1.swofty.net) SDK (MIT).

latest.changelog:
### New
- **Settings on the pause screen.* Pause and press **F8** for an FFB OVERHAUL panel with every setting and a **Reset wheel FFB** button. Changes apply at once and save to your profile. It's keyboard and mouse only: F1 25's pause menu can't be added to, so the panel sits on top of it.
- **Low-FPS smoothing.** When the frame rate drops (after a flashback, in heavy scenes, etc) the game only updates the force once per frame, so the wheel steps. Below 80 FPS the addon now fills in between the game's updates at about 360 HZ on DirectInput wheels (Moza, Fanatec, Simagic, Simucube etc). New setting: Auto / Off / Always.

### Fixed
- **FFB strength jumping after a flashback.*
1: The rewind replays your steering at speed, and the oscillation guard took that for the wheel shaking, adding heavy damping that stayed after the rewind. It now resets after every resume or pause and waits 2s before trusting the steering.
2: Anti-clipping could undo its headroom on frames where it hadn't been applied, making those frames 1.33x too strong.
3: The "FFB went silent" auto-recovery could fire during the rewind and rebuild the wheel's effects. It's removed - the other recovery triggers.
- The speed reading could flip to km/h on one odd value (a rewind can cause one) and stay wrong for the session.

addons.name: Formula NASCAR
addons.author: Formula NASCAR 2023 authors, adapted for F1 25
addons.summary: Formula NASCAR for every 2025 and 2026 car: big draft, near-indestructible wings, stronger brakes, grip that holds up.
addons.description:
# Formula NASCAR for F1 25 + 2026 Season Pack

What if F1 raced like the NASCAR superspeedways? This is an F1 25 port of [Formula NASCAR 2023](https://www.overtake.gg/downloads/formula-nascar-2023.61427/) by **StrongestFish**, built as an addon for [Swofty Launcher](https://f1.swofty.net/). All credit for the concept and tuning goes to StrongestFish. Please check out and rate the original mod!

## Features

- Every car creates a very powerful slipstream as wide as the track, giving Daytona/Talladega-style pack racing and photo finishes
- Slipstream switches off under braking
- Indestructible front wings
- Gearbox damage practically disabled
- Increased grip: tyres keep most of their grip when worn or cold
- Brakes are about 40% stronger, and traction control allows less wheelspin at low speed
- Covers every car: all 2025 teams, all 2026 Season Pack teams (including Cadillac and the 2026 My Team engines) and the FOM cars
- Works in Career, My Team, Grand Prix and split-screen

## How this port differs from the F1 23 version

The F1 23 download shipped full car archives. This port ships only the handling changes, so it is under 1 MB and contains no car models or textures.

The changes were measured against stock F1 23, then applied on top of each F1 25 car's own handling. Brake power and traction-control changes are scaled to each car's stock values, so every 2025 and 2026 car keeps its own brake balance and performance. Engines, aero, the tyre model and the 2026 hybrid system and active aero are untouched.

Your game files stay stock: Swofty swaps the handling in when you press Play, and disabling the addon fully removes it.

## Requirements

- F1 25 (the 2026 Season Pack is supported but not required)
- Swofty Launcher

## Recommended settings

*(from the original mod)*

- Short races (5 laps or 25%) with increased safety cars
- Penalties off or "corner cutting only", as contact with the AI is hard to avoid in the pack
- Raise the AI difficulty to make up for the stronger brakes

## Compatibility

- Compatible with Swofty's *R&D: Tyres & Thermal Management* addon.
- Conflicts with other mods that replace car handling (`.vtf`) files. The one loaded last wins.
- Offline/single player only.

## Credits

- **StrongestFish**: original [Formula NASCAR 2023](https://www.overtake.gg/downloads/formula-nascar-2023.61427/) for F1 23
- **Swofty**: Swofty Launcher and its modding tools

addons.name: Offline Quiet
addons.author: Twilight Sparkle
addons.summary: Skips the EA sign-in popups at boot (EA Login, Online Services Error, Chat Restricted) that modded offline play always shows.
addons.description:
# Offline Quiet for F1 25 (1.0.0)

By Twilight Sparkle. Modded F1 25 always runs offline, so the game greets you with the same EA sign-in
popups on every boot, and you have to click through all of them before you reach the menu. Offline Quiet
hides them and gives each one the same answer you would, so the game goes straight to the main menu.

## What it skips

- **EA Login / Please wait**: answered with *Cancel and play offline*, the button you would press
- **Online Services Error** ("you are signed out of your EA account"): answered with *Okay*
- **Chat Restricted**: answered with *Okay*

The answers go on the next frame, before the popup would even appear. Behind the scenes the game
goes through exactly the same steps as when you click the buttons yourself, so offline play works as before:
Time Trial, Grand Prix, Career, My Team and the other offline modes load normally.

Every other popup is left alone. Messages about saves, settings, controllers or anything else still show up
as usual.

## Settings

In Swofty Launcher open the addon's **Settings**. Each popup has its own switch, all on by default:

- **Skip EA Login**
- **Skip Online Services Error**
- **Skip Chat Restricted**

Turn one off to see that popup again.

## Install
Needs Swofty Launcher 1.6.0 or newer with Swofty Core 0.2.12 or newer. It doesn't change any game files: it
is a small plugin that runs only while the game is started from Swofty. To uninstall, disable or remove the
addon.

## Notes

- Online features stay unavailable, as they are in any modded offline session. This addon only stops the
  game from asking about them.
- The launcher log lists every popup the addon skipped and every other popup the game showed
  (`[offline-quiet]` lines in the session's `loader.log`).

## Credits

Twilight Sparkle, built with the Swofty Launcher native addon SDK.

latest.changelog: Each car now plays its own engine manufacturer's sound from F1 2022. Before, every car played the F1 25 sound of the car it was built on, often another manufacturer's.

versions.changelog: Each car now plays its own engine manufacturer's sound from F1 2022. Before, every car played the F1 25 sound of the car it was built on, often another manufacturer's.
Fixes the cockpit steering wheel: paddles and dials sit where they belong, and the wheel's carbon faceplate no longer shows see-through or stretched.

Every car's driver, steering wheel and cockpit camera now sit where the car's own cockpit expects them: the steering wheel no longer hides inside the chassis, and drivers no longer sink into or sit on top of the cockpit. The rear-facing onboard cameras no longer look through the T-cam pod.

Driver suits now show their front designs on the front and load in their team's colours with boots, with parody sponsors on all kit. Driver select shows every driver's own name. The Red Bull's air intake no longer shows in the onboard cameras.
Fixes the cars having no default setups: the AI now runs proper setups instead of grounding the car and running wide, and the cars are much easier to drive.

Much better frame rates: cars further away now use lighter models instead of the full close-up model. The onboard camera pod now sits where the game's cameras expect it, so it no longer shows in the TV Pod and onboard views. Texture clean-up.
The DRS flap on every car's rear wing now sits where it belongs instead of a few centimetres low inside the main plane, and it opens around its own hinge.

Fixes a crash when starting a Grand Prix with SWOFTY 2022 and other season addons, such as Classic Seasons or the ByDaniX seasons, enabled together. The DRS flap on the rear wing now opens when you use DRS. The halo now sits on the bodywork without a gap. The team and driver names on the menu backdrops no longer swap with Classic Seasons' names when both are enabled.
The SWOFTY 2022 box now shows in the Addons row of Grand Prix and Time Trial on its own, without any other season addon installed.
First release.

addons.name: Sponsor Editor
addons.author: GriffTheSheep
addons.summary: Replace any My Team sponsor's logos with your own PNGs. Pick one on the Sponsor Editor page.
addons.description:
# Sponsor Editor

A Swofty Launcher addon for F1 25 that replaces My Team sponsor logos with your own PNGs.

Once installed a **Sponsor Editor** tab appears in the sidebar.

## Use

Each of the game's sponsors (Avolo, Seren, Xformig and the rest) is a row on the page. The addon edits six images per sponsor

### Ways to set a logo:

- **Drag and drop:** Name the PNG after the sponsor and drop it on the launcher. `avolo.png` sets every style. `avolo_s2.png` sets only Style 2. `avolo_white.png` and `avolo_black.png` also work.
- **Replace all styles:** on a sponsor's row sets every style at once.
- **Open a sponsor's row:** You can see each logo style as pictures. A card for each of the six styles, each with a **Replace…** button. A search box above the list finds a sponsor by name.


Then everything gets built on **next launch**. Your images stay in the addon's data folder, so they survive launcher and addon updates. The switch on each row turns a sponsor's custom logo on or off in the current profile.

## Tips

- Logos are 340×244. Any size works, and the image is fitted for you. A PNG that is already 340×244 is used pixel for pixel.
- Settings on the Addons page: **Fit** (fit, fill or stretch), **Padding** and **Trim transparent edges**.

## Menus and the car

The game keeps two copies of every sponsor logo: a small one (340×244) for the menus and the decal editor, and a bigger one that is painted on the car. The addon replaces both:

- **Menus:** `ui_package/texture_arrays/customisation/sponsor_decals/<sponsor>_<style>_da.erp`.
- **Car:** `eaid://ego_package/decals/textures/<sponsor>_<style>_da.tif`, 1024×1024 with a full mip chain, added to both `shader_package_2025/customisation_decals.nefx2.sm51.erp` and `…sm51_amd.erp`. The launcher writes those two archives into the game folder at build.

## Conflicts

Other addons that replace car sponsor logos (such as Real Life Logos) change the same two archives. If both change the same sponsor, the one later in the load order wins on the car.

## Version info

On launchers older than 1.0.12, which can't draw pictures in a row, the row lists the styles as text instead, and the full-size sheet shows the pictures.

addons.name: Race Broadcast
addons.author: Apoc
addons.summary: Watch AI races like TV: the AI drives your car, the race goes on after a crash, an auto director follows the action, with replays and a four-voice commentary team.
addons.description:
BETA VERSION - VERY EXPERIMENTAL AND WIP WITH FUTURE PATCHES COMING

CREDIT TO: Kizi & RK for the Broadcast/Spectator mode, and AI drive which the addon works using logic from.

Setup Turn on UDP telemetry in the game: Settings > Telemetry > UDP Telemetry On, IP 127.0.0.1, port 20777, format 2025. The director needs it; AI Drive works without it.

Turn off AI Drive and Spectator/Broadcast Mode while using this addon, because they control the same things.

Features

AI Drive (F5): the game's AI takes over your car. Press F5 again to take back control after a 3-second countdown, or let the AI drive from the start. The race carries on after a crash: if your car is wrecked, it's sent to the garage and you keep watching.

Auto director: the camera follows the action by itself. It cuts to crashes, spins, overtakes, cars side by side and close battles, weighted towards the fight for the lead and the podium. The start and restarts stay on the leader for the whole lap unless something happens behind. Broadcast graphics: on-screen captions explain each shot ("BATTLE FOR P4 · RUS 0.4s BEHIND HAM"). The game's timing tower stays up whichever car you're watching. There are LIVE and AI DRIVING tags.

Red flags handled: the broadcast steps aside while the game runs its red flag screens, then picks back up at the restart.

Keys: F3 turns the director on or off, so you can use the game's own camera keys. F4 turns the broadcast on or off.

Optional extras (off by default)

Commentary (beta): a four-voice commentary team with natural British voices that run offline on your PC. Lead commentator Ben Archer and expert Graham Lowe call the race. In longer races, Tom Kirby reports from the pit lane and Erin Doyle covers tyres, strategy and penalties. They stay quiet until lights out, and talk about what the camera is showing. The first use downloads the voices once (about 250 MB). All characters are original.

Replays (experimental): offers replays of contact, starts and big overtakes through the game's Instant Replay. F1 manager style

addons.name: Spectator/Broadcast Mode
addons.author: Kizi & RK
addons.summary: Beta. After you crash the race keeps going and you watch it with the broadcast camera. Can also park you and your teammate in the garage. Idea: Terminal Damage by nyannoying.
addons.description:
# Spectator/Broadcast Mode

**Beta, no promises.** For F1 25 on Steam (build 25251167 or newer) with Swofty Launcher 1.6 or newer. Tested in Grand Prix races only.

> **Please read:** this is the first of two addons that replace **AI Drive + Spectate**. The AI part is now the separate addon **AI Drive**. Don't use the old AI Drive + Spectate together with this addon: both control the same camera.

## What is it?
When you crash out, the game normally ends your race. This addon keeps the race running and lets you **watch the rest of it** with the game's own broadcast camera, switching between drivers with the game's keys. You can also start a race with your car (and your teammate) already in the garage and just watch.

## How to use it
- **After a crash:** just keep the default settings. Your race goes on, the camera moves to a car that is still racing, and your wreck is moved into the garage after 6 seconds.
- **By hand:** press **F4** to start or stop watching at any time.
- **Watch the whole race from the start:** turn on **"Garage start: park my car before the race"**. Your car goes to the garage while you are on the setup screens, and you watch from the start. Turn on **"park my teammate too"** for the second car (needs UDP, see below).
- **While AI Drive is driving:** with **"Watch: start by itself"** on, it switches to the broadcast camera by itself. Turn that off if you only want the AI to drive.

## Settings
- **Watch:** start by itself; move to a car that is still racing.
- **Keys:** the watch key (F4) and your own camera key, pressed once when watching stops so your camera comes back.
- **After a crash:** keep the race going; put my wreck in the garage after 3, 6 or 10 seconds.
- **Garage start:** park my car before the race; park my teammate too.
- **Window:** keep the game running when you click another window.
- **Look:** hide the game logo (applies the next time you press Play).
- **Advanced** (in the launcher's Addons page): telemetry port, pass a copy to another program, detailed log.

## For "park my teammate too": turn on UDP telemetry
Settings > Telemetry: UDP **On**, IP **127.0.0.1**, port **20777**, format **2026**. The addon only opens that port while this option is on. If another tool needs the same port, set its port to 20778 and pick 20778 under "Advanced: pass a copy".

## Recommended settings (what we tested)
- **Defaults are what we tested:** keep the race going ON, wreck to the garage after 6 seconds, start by itself ON, move to a car that is still racing ON, watch key F4, keep the game running ON.
- **Your own camera key:** set it to the key you use to change camera in the game (default C), so your camera comes back when watching stops.
- **Garage start:** leave it OFF unless you want to watch a whole race without driving. "Park my car" works on its own. "Park my teammate too" needs UDP telemetry and is **not confirmed in the game yet**.
- **Tested:** Grand Prix races: a crash keeps the race going, the camera moves to a car that is still racing, the wreck goes to the garage, the HUD stays when you switch cars, and it works together with AI Drive.

## Known limitations
- Without UDP telemetry only your own car is parked, not your teammate.
- Parked cars stay in the garage until the race restarts.
- Because it changes a small part of the game's code while you watch, a game update can break it. The log then says `NOT found` for the missing part.
- If something goes wrong, send the log zip from the launcher (Send Logs).

## For the curious (technical)
- **Keep the race going:** drops the game's "car destroyed" message for your car (a wrap on `Ne_Post_BusMessage`), only for your car and only that message.
- **Garage:** the game's pit lane function (official binding `Game_Pitlane_SetVehicleStatus`, status 9 = in the garage).
- **HUD:** the game hides the HUD every frame while the camera follows another car. While you watch, 20 instructions in the game's code (the "hide" reason) are changed so the HUD stays, and they are restored when you stop.
- **Teammate:** found from the team ids in the game's UDP participants packet.

**Credits:** the idea of keeping your car after terminal damage comes from [Terminal Damage](https://github.com/nyannoying1337/f1-25-terminal-damage) by nyannoying. This addon has its own code, doesn't need Terminal Damage and isn't endorsed by nyannoying. Made by Kizi and RK; the spectate code comes from AI Drive + Spectate. Thanks to Swofty for the official game bindings.

Source: [Source Code](https://github.com/Kizikafuka/f1-25-spectator-broadcast-mode) (MIT).

addons.name: AI Drive
addons.author: Kizi
addons.summary: Beta, races only. Press a key and the game's AI drives your car; press again to take over. Can use the AI teammate's setup and skip the pit stop button press. Needs Swofty 1.7.
addons.description:
# AI Drive

> **Please read:** this is the AI-only version of the old **AI Drive + Spectate**, and it updates it. Watching the race moved to a separate addon, **Spectator/Broadcast Mode**. Install that one too if you want to watch. Don't use the old AI Drive + Spectate together with Spectator/Broadcast Mode.

> **Known limitations (noted by the author in testing, please read first)**
> - **Races only.** Practice and qualifying don't really work: you have to send the AI out of the garage and bring it back to the garage yourself.
> - **The strategy can look odd.** The AI uses the pit plan the game built for your car and doesn't always react like the other AI cars (for example under a safety car).
> - **The formation lap tends to break it.** Turn the AI on after the start.
> - **It can lose pace over a race.** At AI difficulty 110 the car started faster than the field median but lost 0.5 to 1.5 seconds per lap against the game's own AI cars within 7 laps, mostly because its front tyres wore about 25 to 150 % faster than the AI teammate's in the same car. The cause is not known yet, so don't expect it to drive exactly like the other AI cars.
> - **New in 1.1.0 and not tested in the game yet:** the "use the AI teammate's setup" option (it uses Swofty's experimental live car operations) and the pit stop button skip.

## What is it?
Press one key and the game's own AI drives **your** car. Press it again and you drive again. Handy if you want to watch your own race, or test things without driving.

## How to use it
1. Turn the addon on in the launcher and start a race.
2. Press **F5** (or the key you picked) once the race has started. The AI takes your car.
3. Press **F5** again to take over. You can have a short countdown with beeps so you are ready.
Or switch on **"AI drives from the start"** and it takes your car by itself a few seconds after the race starts.

## Settings
- **Start: AI drives from the start of the race:** the AI takes your car by itself after the race starts. Races only.
- **Keys: AI on/off key:** the key for taking and giving back the car (default F5).
- **Keys: take-over countdown:** how long you wait before you get the car back: right away, or 3 or 5 seconds with beeps.
- **Sound: beeps.**
- **Pit: no quick-time event while the AI drives:** with the game's "Immersive pit stops" the stop asks for a button press. The AI can't press it, so the stop came out late. On (default): the game skips that press for your car while the AI drives, and the crew does a normal stop.
- **Setup: use the AI teammate's setup while the AI drives:** on by default, see the next section.

## Your car's setup while the AI drives
- **If this option is OFF (or you use the default setup):** the car uses **your own setup**, the one you picked in the garage. AI Drive does not change it. In our tests we left the setup on the default, and the game's data showed the same values for your car and the AI teammate's (wings, differential, camber, toe, suspension, anti-roll bars, ride height, brake pressure and bias, tyre pressures). We did **not** test a custom setup, so we can't say if a different setup makes the AI faster or slower.
- **If this option is ON (default):** when the AI takes the car, AI Drive looks for the AI car that is the same car as yours (your teammate). **It only copies when exactly one AI car has the same car data as yours.** If several cars look the same, it can't tell your teammate from the others and **keeps your setup** (the log says so). When it does find one, it copies **these values** onto your car: differential on and off throttle, brake bias and pressure, front and rear camber, toe, anti-roll bar and ride height, and ballast. Your own values are saved first, and they come back when you take over. **The wings, tyre pressures and suspension stiffness can't be changed live, so they stay as you set them.** If your setup already matches the AI's (the default), nothing is changed. The log says exactly what was copied (`SETUP:` lines).
- **Fuel load:** the one you set before the race. **Fuel mix:** stays as you set it (Standard in our tests); in one test the menu row was greyed out. **ERS deploy mode:** the AI changes it by itself, like on the AI teammate's car (it switched between Medium and Overtake from lap to lap in our tests).

## What it does NOT do
- It does **not** make pit calls, run a qualifying automatically or re-plan for a safety car (the only pit thing it does is remove the pit stop button press, see the settings above). Your car uses the pit plan the game built for it (in a test, identical to the AI teammate's).

## Recommended settings (what we tested)
- **AI Drive:** "AI drives from the start" ON, take-over countdown 3 seconds, beeps ON.
- **In the game:** leave the car setup on the default and the fuel mix on Standard. Grand Prix races of 3 to 8 laps at AI difficulty up to 110.
- **With Spectator/Broadcast Mode installed:** turn "Watch: start by itself" OFF if you only want the AI to drive, otherwise it switches to the broadcast camera.

## If something goes wrong
Send the log zip from the launcher (Send Logs). Please say which session type you used and what the AI difficulty was.

## For the curious (technical)
It uses Swofty's official `sessions::set_control` to switch your car's controller to the game's AI controller, with no private bindings. One small code patch is installed at load for the pit stop quick-time event: a stub in front of the block that starts the countdown, which jumps past it only for your car and only while the AI drives (otherwise the game's own instructions run). Ported from Manual Pit Lane, where it was tested.
The setup option uses Swofty 1.7's `cars::live` `get` and `set` (experimental, "not run in game yet" in Swofty's own notes). The AI car must be the only AI car whose steering lock, clutch torque, final drive, gear ratios and engine limiter are identical to yours, otherwise nothing is copied. Only values that differ are written.
When the game takes the car back (flashback, restart, garage), it waits 2.5 seconds and takes it again. 
In one 5-lap race the AI Drive car burnt 1.04 kg of fuel per lap and the AI teammate 1.05 kg, with tyre wear of +3.6 % and +3.4 % per lap. This is one test, not a guarantee.

**Credits:** made by Kizi. Thanks to Swofty for the launcher, the addon system and the official game calls.

addons.name: Team Orders
addons.author: Jonno
addons.summary: Give your AI teammate radio orders: box, stay out, let you through, hold, defend, push or save tyres.
addons.description:
# Team Orders

Orders you have to earn, with consequences. Thanks to everyone who suggested
these.

**Team Orders** adds a new page to the in-race radio menu in F1 25. From it you can give your AI teammate real orders, and they follow them.

**Orders**
- **Let Me Through**: your teammate backs off and lets you past.
- **Hold Position**: they won't attack you from behind.
- **Defend Against Rival**: they use ERS and max fuel mix when a rival closes in.
- **Push Now**: ERS overtake mode, max fuel mix, and they drive closer to the limit.
- **Conserve Tyres**: they drive under the limit to save their tyres.
- **Box This Lap**: they pit this lap, whatever their strategy says.
- **Cancel Team Orders**: back to their own plan.

### New: Realistic rules (on by default)

- **Let them race.** No team orders while you and your teammate are fighting
  for the win or a podium (the leading car of the two is in the top 3 and you're
  within ~2s of each other).
- **Box This Lap** only inside your teammate's pit window, or when their
  strategy already wants a stop (tyre wear, damage, weather, safety car). Too
  early and you're told which lap the window opens.
- **Let Me Through** only when you're within ~1.5s behind and clearly faster:
  your last lap at least 0.3s quicker, or you've closed 0.5s recently. A
  pop-up tells you when it's available.
- **Use it or give it back.** Once let through, you have 2 laps to pull 1 s
  clear. If you don't, you're told to give the place back.
- **Teammate trust.** Keep a place you should have given back and your
  teammate's trust drops. Below 50% they refuse Let Me Through; below 25%,
  Hold Position too. Clean laps and keeping your word win it back.
- Turn **Realistic rules** off in the addon settings for the original
  anything-goes orders.

latest.changelog:
- Removes unsolicited faster/Let Me Through availability popup.
- Replaces repeated heap-region checks with bounded, protected memory copies.
- Batches AI, roster, lap and strategy reads into small snapshots.
- Limits monitoring to one worker at a time without making other frame
  callbacks wait - makes polling and pause-clock state safe across workers.
- Skips idle monitoring when disabled and skips pace-history reads when
  realistic rules are off. AI snapshot publication also avoids waiting.
- Defers session cleanup to the monitoring worker and rejects driving inputs
  from a previous session immediately.
- Adds **Stay Out** to the native Team Orders radio page.
- Delays a scheduled stop due this lap until the next lap, then resumes normal
  strategy. Future stops remain unchanged - no extra stop is created.
- Supports replacing Box This Lap with Stay Out, and vice versa, through the
  existing owned-edit cancellation path.
- Cancel restores an unchanged delay before it expires. Native pit reasons,
  changed plans and committed pit entry take priority.
- Push Now adds a **9% relative MGU-K harvesting-efficiency boost**, capped at
  100% efficiency. Cars already near the cap receive a smaller improvement.
- Recovery uses the native physics calculation. Battery capacity, lap harvest
  and deployment limits, and maximum deployment power stay unchanged - a full
  battery or reached harvest limit can leave no benefit.
- The recharge boost clears with Cancel, another driving order or session
  changes, and suspends when paused or current race/control data is unavailable.
  A rebuilt physical car needs a fresh Push command.

versions.changelog:
- Removes unsolicited faster/Let Me Through availability popup.
- Replaces repeated heap-region checks with bounded, protected memory copies.
- Batches AI, roster, lap and strategy reads into small snapshots.
- Limits monitoring to one worker at a time without making other frame
  callbacks wait - makes polling and pause-clock state safe across workers.
- Skips idle monitoring when disabled and skips pace-history reads when
  realistic rules are off. AI snapshot publication also avoids waiting.
- Defers session cleanup to the monitoring worker and rejects driving inputs
  from a previous session immediately.
- Adds **Stay Out** to the native Team Orders radio page.
- Delays a scheduled stop due this lap until the next lap, then resumes normal
  strategy. Future stops remain unchanged - no extra stop is created.
- Supports replacing Box This Lap with Stay Out, and vice versa, through the
  existing owned-edit cancellation path.
- Cancel restores an unchanged delay before it expires. Native pit reasons,
  changed plans and committed pit entry take priority.
- Push Now adds a **9% relative MGU-K harvesting-efficiency boost**, capped at
  100% efficiency. Cars already near the cap receive a smaller improvement.
- Recovery uses the native physics calculation. Battery capacity, lap harvest
  and deployment limits, and maximum deployment power stay unchanged - a full
  battery or reached harvest limit can leave no benefit.
- The recharge boost clears with Cancel, another driving order or session
  changes, and suspends when paused or current race/control data is unavailable.
  A rebuilt physical car needs a fresh Push command.

- Fixes a 32-record entrant-list limit that prevented orders from reaching
  teammate lookup in larger My Team/Driver Career rosters.
- Reads the larger career roster and includes only drivers assigned to race
  cars. Unassigned drivers and free agents do not count as extra teammates.
- Matches teammates using the game's team stat ID, preserving custom driver
  identity and current-season lineup support.
- Keeps the checks for human teammates, ambiguous car assignments and genuine
  race-control restrictions. Waits while the game is updating the lineup.
- Replaces the generic "Can't give orders now" popup with specific short
  reasons. Rejection details are logged even when detailed logging is off.

- Stops race monitoring while paused.
- Reduces background checks and repeated settings lookups.
- Reuses teammate data until the lineup or session changes.
- Avoids waiting on busy AI strategy updates, targeting reported frame-time spikes.
- Pausing no longer uses up team-order timeouts.

### New: Realistic rules (on by default)

- **Let them race.** No team orders while you and your teammate are fighting
  for the win or a podium (the leading car of the two is in the top 3 and you're
  within ~2 s of each other).
- **Box This Lap** only inside your teammate's pit window, or when their
  strategy already wants a stop (tyre wear, damage, weather, safety car). Too
  early and you're told which lap the window opens.
- **Let Me Through** only when you're within ~1.5 s behind and clearly faster:
  your last lap at least 0.3 s quicker, or you've closed 0.5 s recently. A
  pop-up tells you when it's available.
- **Use it or give it back.** Once let through, you have 2 laps to pull 1 s
  clear. If you don't, you're told to give the place back.
- **Teammate trust.** Keep a place you should have given back and your
  teammate's trust drops. Below 50% they refuse Let Me Through; below 25%,
  Hold Position too. Clean laps and keeping your word win it back.
- Turn **Realistic rules** off in the addon settings for the original
  anything-goes orders.

### Changes

- Let Me Through now says "Already ahead of teammate." straight away when
  you're already ahead.
- Hold Position is refused when your teammate isn't near you (more than ~3 s
  apart): "Teammate isn't near you."
Initial release

### Using it
Open **Shaders** in the launcher, pick **Broadcast Onboard** and choose **Use**. The key on the Shaders page (B by default) turns shaders on and off in game. **Copy to personal** makes your own copy to tune; set `strength = 0` under `[stream_encoder]` for a clean picture without stream artefacts.

The launcher's own effects: `perspective` for a mild wide-lens curve, then `broadcast_camera`, `hue_target`, `broadcast_lens` and `stream_encoder`. It looks best on an onboard camera, such as TV Pod Offset.

Needs Swofty Launcher 1.8.14 or later.

addons.name: Adelaide Street Circuit (1985-1995)
addons.author: Jonno
addons.summary: (TRACK NOT MADE WITH AI) - F1 Adelaide Street Circuit as it was from 1985-1995.
addons.description:
**(NO AI WAS USED IN THE MAKING OF THIS TRACK, ONLY FOR PORTING IT TO F1 25)**

# Adelaide Street Circuit 1985-1995
*Version 0.1.0 alpha, F1 25 + SwoftyLauncher*

The old Australian GP track is back. Victoria Park pit straight, the run up Wakefield Road, the 90 degree corners on East Terrace, Brewery Bend onto Brabham Straight and the hairpin at the end of it. This is the F1 layout used from 1985 to 1995.

It's an alpha. It drives properly, the AI race on it and you can do full weekends, but there are rough edges (see known issues). I'd rather get it out now and fix things with your feedback than sit on it for another month.

## What's in it
- Layout traced from OpenStreetMap street data and checked against period track maps. Elevation comes from Geoscience Australia LiDAR. Just over 3.8km, 16 turns, clockwise.
- Concrete walls all the way round with 90s style boards on them: EDS, Foster's, Marlboro, Mobil 1, Goodyear and the blue ADELAIDE boards.
- The EDS banner bridge over Wakefield Road and the Foster's one over Brabham Straight.
- Catch fencing on the walls, the tyre wall at Brewery Bend, and gravel traps and run-off placed from photos and race footage.
- Parklands full of trees, buildings along the street sections and grandstands at the main spectator spots.
- Pit lane on the main straight with 11 garages.
- AI tuned corner by corner.
- Its own name, flag, menu art and trivia in the menus, with lap counts and fuel set for the track length.
- Higher tyre wear, and a lower ERS harvest limit for the 2026 cars so you can't just deploy the whole lap.

## Requirements
- F1 25
- SwoftyLauncher 1.7.0 or newer

## Install
1. Drag the `.swoftyaddon` file onto the SwoftyLauncher window.
2. Enable it in your profile, then build and launch like normal.
3. Pick Adelaide from the track list.

## Known issues
- Replay and TV cameras are the big one. A lot of shots are too far from the cars or cut at the wrong moment and the pan at the start of a race can just show grass. Working on it.
- The AI is way better than it was but still a bit off in a couple of spots.
- The trackside stuff is my best take on 1995 from photos and onboards, not a laser scan.

If you find something, a screenshot and roughly where on the lap it was helps a lot.

## Credits
- Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Elevation © Geoscience Australia (CC BY 4.0).
- Built with F1MapEditor (GPL-3.0) on the Portimao base package. Big thanks to them!
- SwoftyLauncher by Swofty-Developments
- Sponsor names are plain lettering. The trademarks belong to their owners.
- Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with EA, Codemasters or Formula One Group.

addons.name: Heavier Damage + 2026 Realism Performance
addons.author: william09leo
addons.summary: Heavier damage on every car (2025, 2026, My Team) with 4 levels: Stock, Light, Normal, Heavy. Real crashes end races, light taps don't. 2026 cars also get the Career Realism Overhaul performance (can be switched off).
addons.description:
**Crashes actually hurt now - for you AND the AI.**

- Hit something hard and your wing breaks, or your race is over.
- Small taps and lap 1 bumping won't ruin your race.
- Choose your own damage strength for wings and suspension.
- The 2026 cars drive more like the real thing, using the 2026 Career Realism Overhaul's car performance.

*Offline / single-player only.*

🤝 **Works with Terminal Damage** by nyannoying: keep your broken car and limp on, pull over or pit. See "Works with" below.

## One mod, two parts
- **Heavier damage** (all cars) - you can turn this off: set both damage settings to **Stock**.
- **Realism performance** (2026 cars) - you can turn this off too: set **2026 car performance** to **Stock (EA)**. New in v1.1.

## What you need
- F1 25 with the 2026 Season Pack
- Swofty Launcher 1.5.22 or newer

## How to install
1. Click **Install** on this addon.
2. Go to **Addons** and click its switch to turn it on.
3. Optional: click the addon to choose your damage strength (Normal is the default).
4. Press **Play**, and set **Car Damage** to **SIMULATION** in the game.

Swofty Launcher only loads the mod while you play, and puts the game back to normal when you quit.
To remove it: turn the addon off (or remove it) on the Addons page.

## Playing online
Mods only work offline. Before you play online again (even with the mods turned off), check your game files first:
- **Steam:** right-click F1 25 > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files.
- **EA app:** find F1 25 in your Library, click the 3 dots (...) > Repair.

Then start F1 25 from Steam or the EA app, not from Swofty Launcher.

## Which cars and parts
- **Heavier damage:** every car - 2025, 2026 and My Team, including EA's special one-off liveries. Only the front wing and the suspension & wheels. Tyres, punctures and engine damage are untouched.
- **Realism performance:** 2026 cars only - weight, downforce, drag, engine and battery power, all the Realism Overhaul author's numbers. The 2025 cars keep EA's normal performance.

## Damage settings
Two settings:
- **Front wing damage** - how easily your front wing breaks.
- **Suspension & wheel damage** - how easily a crash breaks your suspension or knocks a wheel off.

Each one has 4 levels:
- **Stock (EA)** - the game's normal damage (no change). Suspension almost never breaks.
- **Light** - a bit more damage than normal. A good start if you're new.
- **Normal (recommended)** - big hits break things, small taps don't. Real crashes end races.
- **Heavy** - lots of damage. Wings fall off easily - every mistake can cost you.

How to change them:
1. Click the addon in Swofty Launcher (or in game, go to ADDON SETTINGS).
2. Pick a level for each setting.
3. Restart the game - the new level works from your next start.

**2026 car performance** (new in v1.1):
- **Realism (recommended)** - the 2026 Career Realism Overhaul's team pace and car performance.
- **Stock (EA)** - the game's own 2026 performance. You get the damage only.

Just want the Realism performance? Set both damage settings to **Stock**.
Just want the damage? Set **2026 car performance** to **Stock (EA)**.

## Best AI settings right now
Kizikafuka's **AI Racing Tweaks** is the best partner for this mod - its defaults are a good start. Change 2 settings first:
1. **Damaged car driving → Careful (game).** On the default (Pushing), damaged AI keep their pace, so damage looks like it does nothing.
2. **Equal weight → On.** The game makes your car count heavier, so AI barely move when you hit them (you get pushed more too).

Then tune:
- **Not enough contact?** Space kept from cars → Very tight, wheel-to-wheel push → Medium.
- **Not enough damage?** This mod → Heavy.
- **Too many retirements?** This mod → Light.

Racecraft and car control settings need a game restart. **F1 25 + 26 More Aggressive AI** (a track pack, no settings) makes the AI race harder too. Both are in the Addon Browser. *Based on AI Racing Tweaks 0.3.2 (experimental).*


## Works with / doesn't work with
**Works with:**
- Extra track addons
- Kizikafuka's AI mods (above)
- **Terminal Damage** by nyannoying - tested together by its maker. This mod decides how easily things break, Terminal Damage what happens after. Using its *Suspension damage from hits* too? Follow that setting's note: both mods damage the suspension.

**Doesn't work with:**
- Other mods that change the cars' handling, performance or damage files (e.g. Formula NASCAR) - only one can be active.
- The Realism Overhaul's own "SERPs Performance" zip - this mod already includes that performance.

**Not checked:**
- Liveries. Some liveries replace a team's whole car file, which can undo this mod for that team. If one team feels wrong, turn its livery off to check.

## Something wrong or got an idea?
Turn the addon off, then tell me in the Discussion tab on the [overtake page](https://www.overtake.gg/downloads/swofty-addon-heavier-damage-2025-2026-cars-2026-realism-performance.88019/):
what happened, which track and car, your damage settings and which other mods you had on.

Ideas are welcome too - new options, other parts that should break (or not), different levels. The best ideas go into future updates.

## ⏰ When I'm busy
- **Mondays and Wednesdays:** I race in an F1 league.
- **Real F1 race weekends:** I watch every qualifying, sprint and race live, and sometimes practice.

On those days I might not have time to make improvements or run tests, so things can take a bit longer.

## 🗺️ Roadmap
*Rough times - they depend on how testing goes and my busy days.*

### ✅ Done
- Heavier damage for every car (2025, 2026, My Team)
- Damage settings: Stock / Light / Normal / Heavy for the wing and suspension
- Swofty Launcher version (v1.0.1)
- **Realism on/off** - use the damage without the 2026 performance (v1.1)

### On hold - v1.2, live settings
Change things in ADDON SETTINGS between races - no game restart. On hold while I work on other mods.
- ⏸️ **Front wing damage** - works in my tests. *Small job left.*
- ⏸️ **Battery strength** for every car, AI included - works in my tests. *Small job left.*
- ❌ **Live suspension & wheel damage** - not for now: Terminal Damage's suspension damage covers this.

### Later
- 📅 Realism Overhaul updates - *small job each time*, a few days after each one
- 📅 More damage options, like punctures from debris - not looked into yet, only if people want them
- 📅 Your ideas from the Discussion tab

✅ done · ⚙️ being built · ☑️ ready to build · 📅 planned · ⏸️ on hold · ❌ not for now

## Credits
- **Rhino** - made the damage mod this one is built on (values reused with permission). [F1 25 and 26 Cars Damage Mod](https://www.overtake.gg/downloads/f1-25-and-26-cars-damage-mod.84549/)
- **oknomis09** - the original F1 25 damage values Rhino used.
- **IveAlreadyWon34** - the 2026 Career Realism Overhaul (car performance, used with permission). [2026 Career Realism Overhaul](https://www.overtake.gg/downloads/2026-career-realism-overhaul-post-bahrain.86712/)
- **Swofty Developments** - Swofty Launcher.
- **Petar Tasev** - the Ego Engine Modding library, used to edit the car files.

## Version history
- **1.1.0** - New "2026 car performance" setting (Realism or Stock), clearer setting texts, needs Swofty Launcher 1.5.22+. Damage and Realism performance unchanged.
- **1.0.1** - Needs Swofty Launcher 1.5.17+, links to the overtake page.
- **1.0** - First release.

addons.name: Project Aeternum
addons.author: Apoc
addons.summary: Project Aeternum's broadcast overlays, set up from the launcher: all its settings in a panel, opened with the game, updates, and telemetry shared with Race Broadcast. Includes the Project Aeternum installer.
addons.description:
Project Aeternum's broadcast overlays, set up and run from the Swofty Launcher.

In order to get Aeternum working you need to install it, this is a separate app which runs alongside Swofty

Project Aeternum is a broadcast overlay app for F1 25 made by Simracing Centre: a live leaderboard, car status, tyre life, track map, pit lane, battle graphics and much more, drawn over the game. This addon brings all of it into the launcher, so you don't have to manage a second app.

WHAT IT DOES
- Installs Project Aeternum for you (the official installer is included).
- Opens Aeternum with the game and runs it in the background: only the game and the overlays show, and Aeternum closes when the game closes.
- Puts all of Aeternum's settings in a launcher panel: general settings, overlay profiles, every overlay's options (styles, units, colours), hotkeys, and a button to edit the overlay layout.
- Your panel settings are applied every time you press Play, with a separate set for each launcher profile.
- Checks for Aeternum updates and installs them from the launcher.

WHAT YOU NEED TO ENABLE
1. In the panel, press Install Project Aeternum, then open it once.
2. In F1 25: Settings > Telemetry > UDP Telemetry On, UDP IP 127.0.0.1, port 20777, UDP format 2026 (for the 2026 teams' colours and logos).
3. Set the game's display mode to Windowed Fullscreen (borderless). In exclusive Fullscreen the overlays are hidden.
CREDITS
Project Aeternum is made by Simracing Centre and used with their permission. All of Aeternum's overlays, graphics and branding belong to them. Join their Discord for help with Aeternum: discord.gg/simracingcentre (also on the panel's Support tab).

This addon is created with their permission.
Swofty panel by Apoc.
