addons.description:
# REWIND

**F1 25, as it would have looked on screen in every decade of the championship.**

Ever wondered what a modern grid would look like on a 1950s newsreel, taped off the telly in 1988, or broadcast in grainy 2000s digital SD? **Rewind** is a shader pack for the **Swofty Launcher** with **eight presets, one per decade**. Each one recreates the actual cameras, film stock, tape and broadcast technology of its era, so the picture changes the way real footage did. They're not just filters slapped on top.

The HUD always draws on top, untouched, so you can race with any of them.

## The eras

- **1950s, Newsreel:** black-and-white 35mm film shot through a yellow filter, 24 fps with authentic judder, hard contrast, gate weave, flicker, grain, dust and scratches, 1.37:1 frame.
- **1960s, Eastmancolor 16mm:** colour film as it survives today, its faded dyes leaving that warm magenta cast, with soft lenses, red halation glow and chunky 16mm grain.
- **1970s, Tube Camera Broadcast:** tube TV cameras: warm, oversaturated, soft, with bright "comet tails" trailing highlights, ghosting and blown-out whites in 4:3.
- **1980s, VHS Off-Air Recording:** the race taped off the TV, with smeared colour, washed-out blacks, sharpening halos, the tear at the bottom of the screen and tape dropouts.
- **1990s, CCD Broadcast:** early digital-sensor cameras, crisp for standard definition, with punchy colour, strong edge sharpening and vertical light streaks from the sun on paint and glass.
- **2000s, Digital SD Broadcast:** digital satellite TV, with blocky compression that falls apart in rain spray, a cool digital look and 4:3 (the world feed went widescreen in 2007).
- **2010s, HD Broadcast:** the 2011-era HD feed: clean, sharpened, punchy, deep blacks, 16:9.
- **2020s, UHD Cinematic:** today's 4K HDR look, with soft highlight rolloff, rich contrast, gentle glow and fine grain.

## Highlights

- Built from research into how each decade's footage actually looked: dye fading, tube lag, CCD smear, VHS bandwidth, MPEG-2 blocking and more.
- Real 24 fps film cadence for the film eras, not just a filter.
- Looks the same at 1080p, 1440p and 4K, because every effect scales with your resolution.
- HDR supported (see the tips below).
- Fully tweakable: copy any preset to your own config and adjust it in the Shaders editor. Every setting has a hover description.
- Three effects you can mix in your own configs: **Film Stock** (`rewind_film`), **Video Signal** (`rewind_video`) and **Film Cadence** (`rewind_cadence`).

## Tips

- **Frame Generation:** turn it off for the 1950s and 1960s presets, or it smooths away the 24 fps film judder. The VHS line wobble can also smear with it on.
- **HDR:** set *HDR paper white* in the preset to match your in-game HDR paper white.
- **Performance:** the video-era presets (1970s to 2010s) are the heaviest. If one runs too slowly, Swofty switches it off and notes it in `swofty/loader.log`.
- **"Reserved (unused)" setting:** leave it alone. It works around a quirk in the launcher's shader preview.

addons.name: Lap 1 Realistic AI
addons.author: Swofty
addons.summary: On lap 1 the AI races like a real opening lap: the pack brakes later, followers go for the inside instead of queueing, cars stay side by side into corners and defend from further back. Each AI car goes back to normal when it finishes lap 1. No settings.
addons.description:
On lap 1 the AI races like a real opening lap. The pack brakes later, followers go for the inside instead of queueing behind the car ahead, cars stay side by side into the corners, and every car defends against you from further back. Each AI car goes back to the game's normal behaviour when it crosses the line to start lap 2.

Needs Swofty Launcher 1.8.6 or later. No settings: turn it on and race.

## What changes on lap 1

- **Pace:** every AI car plans its braking points and corner speeds from 10 % more grip, so the pack stops braking early in traffic. Dry races only.
- **Going for the inside:** a follower starts an overtake from 4 car lengths instead of 1.5, its overtake window is about four times as long, and a car ahead braking early no longer cancels the move.
- **Leaving the queue:** a car pulls out of a queue after 0.3 s behind one car, instead of waiting 2 s behind three.
- **Side by side into corners:** a car may stay off the racing line into a corner (the game pulls it back onto the line), and a car boxed in by traffic holds its place instead of dropping back after 5 s. Cars alongside yield half as much.
- **Defending:** an AI car defends against attackers up to 45 m behind (the game uses 18 m) and treats slower-closing cars as threats too.

Races and sprints, every track, every season and every car. Works with other AI addons: Contact Physics and AI Driver Behaviour stack with it, and their pace settings multiply with this one.

## Good to know

- Expect more contact between AI cars on lap 1: they race each other now.
- A red flag restart is a new lap 1.
- Your `loader.log` shows the values the AI reads on lap 1 and after it, in `[lap1-ai]` lines.

addons.name: More Sponsor Slots
addons.author: JonnieDesigns
addons.summary: This add-on allows for more decals to be added to a livery in F1 world and in MyTeam
addons.description:
This addon raises the decal limit of every area on the car, on the 2025 and 2026 cars, in the F1 World and My Team livery editors.

## Decals per area (stock → with this addon)

- **Sidepods:** 10 → 20 on each side
- **Nose top:** 6 → 22
- **Nose sides:** 4 → 9 on each side
- **Front wing:** 6 → 12, endplates 3 → 5 each
- **Rear wing:** top 6 → 10, underside 4 → 10, endplates 4 → 10 each
- **Halo:** inside 4 → 10, sides 4 → 8 each, top 6 → 14
- **Mirrors:** 2 → 4 each

That is **190 decals** in total instead of 86.

## My Team career

- Every sponsor level unlocks more slots, from level 1 on. The sidepods, for example, start at 6 slots each instead of 2 and reach 20.
- To keep the budget fair, income per decal is a little lower when you run many decals:
  - 21–40 decals: 12,000 instead of 15,000
  - 41–70 decals: 8,000 instead of 10,000
  - 71–90 decals: 3,500 instead of 5,000

Changes only the game database; no game files are replaced. Works together with Sponsor Studio sponsor addons.

addons.summary: Adds a new Driver Career R&D department, Tyres & Thermal Management, alongside the stock four. My Team is blocked while it is on.
addons.description:
Adds a fifth R&D department to **Driver Career**: **Tyres & Thermal Management**, with 15 upgrades next to the stock four departments. Its upgrades:

- help keep the tyres in their optimal temperature window
- reduce the brake heat that reaches the tyres
- improve tyre life
- improve power unit cooling

### Good to know
- It's built for Driver Career. My Team careers can't be played while it's on, so switch it off in the profile you use for My Team.
- It works on saves you already have.
- Loading a save without the addon clears that save's Tyres & Thermal upgrades. Apart from that, you can turn it on and off freely.
